name: Black 20
notes: Type B from the 2019 game photos, not from this art: a red stripe over the top of the shoulder pad and down the outer sleeve, ending above the cuff, with a thin white outline. The photos show it as a red panel with black claw cuts and thin white accents; this is the simplified stripe Doc asked for. width_m, fromNeck_m and outline.width_m are meters on the 3D jersey (estimates from the photos); endFromHem is a fraction of L like the bands. The art's own sleeve bands (Type A, like Red 20) are kept in artBands for reference and are not drawn.
how: from/to are fractions of the sleeve length L, measured along the sleeve from the hem edge; L = hem to the top of the shoulder cap along the outer sleeve line in the art (same template for every jersey). mm uses the 3D jersey: hem to shoulder top = 0.168 m.
